No runtime consumer, native/vendor, schema, policy, oracle, fixture or public API edit exists in the renewal. This approves changed source for fresh qualification only and supersedes the previous approval for this changed closure without erasing any predecessor/failed evidence. Fresh final artifact qualification, installation/testing, exact-head FULL CI and separate independent spatial/implementation/artifact acceptance remain required. No merge, issue closure, Checkpoint-B/#95 acceptance or Phase C authority is implied.
